title: General FAQs
description: About iFranchise and how we work with you.

questions.q: What is iFranchise?
questions.a: iFranchise is a franchise consulting and development platform that helps brands build, launch, and scale franchise businesses while helping investors discover franchise opportunities that align with their goals.

questions.q: What does iFranchise do?
questions.a: We work across the franchise journey—from understanding the business and market to developing the franchise model, positioning the opportunity, planning the launch, supporting franchise sales, and enabling ongoing growth.

questions.q: Who can work with iFranchise?
questions.a: iFranchise works with both brands looking to expand through franchising and investors looking for structured franchise opportunities.

questions.q: Does iFranchise sell franchises?
questions.a: iFranchise facilitates franchise opportunities on behalf of brands. We help investors understand the opportunity, business model, investment requirements, and suitability before they move forward.

questions.q: How does iFranchise select the brands it works with?
questions.a: We look at factors such as the brand's business model, market potential, positioning, scalability, operational readiness, and growth plans before developing a franchise strategy.

questions.q: What types of businesses can franchise?
questions.a: Businesses across categories such as F&B, retail, beauty, fitness, education, lifestyle, and services can potentially be franchised, provided the business model is suitable for expansion.

questions.q: How do I get started with iFranchise?
questions.a: You can submit an enquiry through our website. Our team will understand your requirements and guide you toward the relevant next step.

questions.q: Does iFranchise guarantee franchise success or returns?
questions.a: No. Franchise performance depends on several factors, including location, investment, operations, market conditions, and execution. iFranchise focuses on creating a structured opportunity and helping both brands and investors make informed decisions.

title: For investors
description: Explore franchise opportunities and understand what comes next.

questions.q: What kind of franchise opportunities can I find through iFranchise?
questions.a: iFranchise works with brands across multiple sectors and investment levels. Available opportunities vary based on the brands we are currently representing.

questions.q: How do I find the right franchise opportunity for me?
questions.a: We consider factors such as your investment capacity, preferred location, business experience, involvement level, category preference, and growth objectives to help identify suitable opportunities.

questions.q: How much investment is required to start a franchise?
questions.a: Investment requirements vary significantly depending on the brand, format, location, and franchise model. Each opportunity has its own investment structure, which will be explained before you proceed.

questions.q: Do I need previous business experience?
questions.a: Not necessarily. Some franchise models are designed for first-time entrepreneurs, while others may benefit from prior business or category experience.

questions.q: Can I own a franchise without managing it every day?
questions.a: Some franchise models are designed to allow greater owner involvement flexibility. However, the level of involvement depends on the specific brand, operating model, and agreement.

questions.q: What is FICO, FOCO or other franchise models?
questions.a: These are different franchise operating and ownership structures that define how the franchise is funded, operated, and managed. The applicable model depends on the brand and opportunity.

questions.q: How does iFranchise help investors?
questions.a: We help investors understand the brand, business model, investment requirements, franchise structure, market opportunity, and expected responsibilities so they can evaluate an opportunity more clearly.

questions.q: Can I speak directly with the brand before investing?
questions.a: Yes. Once an investor is qualified and interested in an opportunity, the relevant discussions with the brand can be facilitated as part of the process.

questions.q: Can I choose the city or location for my franchise?
questions.a: Location availability depends on the brand's expansion strategy and territory availability. Our team can help assess potential locations based on the brand's requirements.

questions.q: Are franchise returns guaranteed?
questions.a: No. Any projected revenue, profitability, or return figures should be treated as estimates or projections unless expressly guaranteed under a legally binding agreement. Actual performance can vary.

questions.q: What happens after I submit an enquiry?
questions.a: Our team reviews your requirements, understands your investment objectives, and connects you with relevant opportunities where there is a suitable fit.

questions.q: Is iFranchise the franchise owner?
questions.a: No. iFranchise acts as a franchise consulting and development partner for brands and facilitates connections between brands and prospective investors.

title: For brands
description: Prepare your business for franchise development and expansion.

questions.q: Why should my business consider franchising?
questions.a: Franchising can provide a structured way to expand into new markets while leveraging franchise partners for investment and local execution. However, the business needs the right model and operational foundation before scaling.

questions.q: Is every business suitable for franchising?
questions.a: No. A business should have a proven and replicable model, clear operations, a strong value proposition, and sufficient potential for expansion. iFranchise can help assess franchise readiness.

questions.q: How does iFranchise help brands become franchise-ready?
questions.a: We evaluate the existing business and work on areas such as franchise model development, positioning, market analysis, operational structure, expansion strategy, and franchise sales.

questions.q: What franchise models can iFranchise help develop?
questions.a: Depending on the business, we can help structure models such as FICO, FOCO, FIFO, and other customized franchise structures suited to the brand's requirements.

questions.q: How do I know which franchise model is right for my brand?
questions.a: There is no one-size-fits-all model. The right structure depends on factors such as capital requirements, operational control, brand objectives, investor profile, margins, and scalability.

questions.q: Does iFranchise help with franchise marketing?
questions.a: Yes. We can support the positioning and go-to-market strategy for a franchise opportunity, including communication, lead generation, franchise marketing, and sales enablement.

questions.q: Does iFranchise help find franchise investors?
questions.a: Yes. Franchise development can include identifying, generating, qualifying, and facilitating conversations with prospective franchise partners.

questions.q: Can iFranchise help us expand into new cities?
questions.a: Yes. We can support market and expansion planning to identify potential markets based on the brand's business model, target audience, competition, and expansion objectives.

questions.q: Does iFranchise handle franchise sales?
questions.a: We can support the franchise sales process, from generating and qualifying enquiries to facilitating conversations between the brand and prospective franchise partners.

questions.q: What information does iFranchise need from a brand?
questions.a: Typically, we would look at information such as your business model, existing locations, financial structure, operations, target markets, expansion plans, investment requirements, and current brand positioning.

questions.q: How long does it take to franchise a business?
questions.a: There is no fixed timeline. It depends on the brand's existing infrastructure, readiness, business model, documentation, operational systems, and the scope of work required.

questions.q: Can an early-stage or growing brand work with iFranchise?
questions.a: Potentially, yes. The suitability depends on the strength and replicability of the business model and its readiness for structured expansion.

questions.q: Does iFranchise guarantee that we will get franchisees?
questions.a: No. Franchise development depends on market demand, the strength of the opportunity, investment requirements, brand readiness, and investor interest. iFranchise's role is to build and support the process rather than guarantee a particular number of franchise partners.

questions.q: How can a brand get started with iFranchise?
questions.a: Start by submitting an enquiry. Our team can understand your current business, expansion objectives, and franchise ambitions before recommending the appropriate next steps.
